title: kith-core: error types
description:
What: Define KithError, JmapError, and AuthError types in src/error.rs. Requires thiserror dep (KITH-bhl.1).

Module file: crates/kith-core/src/error.rs — create this file, then add 'pub mod error;' to src/lib.rs.

Algorithm:
1. Import: use thiserror::Error;
2. Define AuthError enum:
   #[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
   Variants:
   - NoPeerAddr  → #[error("no peer address on request")]
   - WhoIsFailed(String)  → #[error("WhoIs failed: {0}")]
   - Unauthorized  → #[error("caller is not authorized")]
3. Define JmapError struct (serializable error for JMAP method responses):
   #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, thiserror::Error)]
   #[error("{error_type}: {description:?}")]
   Fields:
   - error_type: String  → #[serde(rename="type")]
   - description: Option<String>  → #[serde(skip_serializing_if="Option::is_none")]
   Include const fn for common error types:
   impl JmapError {
     pub fn invalid_arguments(desc: impl Into<String>) -> Self { ... }
     pub fn forbidden_method() -> Self { ... }
     pub fn not_found() -> Self { ... }
     pub fn server_fail(desc: impl Into<String>) -> Self { ... }
   }
4. Define KithError top-level enum wrapping other errors:
   #[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
   Variants:
   - Auth(#[from] AuthError)  → #[error(transparent)]
   - Jmap(JmapError)  → #[error(transparent)]
   - Store(String)  → #[error("storage error: {0}")]
   - Validation(String)  → #[error("validation error: {0}")]
5. Add 'pub mod error;' to src/lib.rs.
6. Run: cargo check -p kith-core

Defensive programming rules:
- Error messages must NOT include raw user-supplied data from untrusted sources
- Use #[from] only for typed conversions, not for String (String errors are internal)
- No unwrap() in error constructors

Tests (independent oracle: manually specified error type strings per RFC 8620 §7.1):
- JmapError::invalid_arguments("test") serializes to {"type":"invalidArguments","description":"test"}
- JmapError::forbidden_method() serializes to {"type":"forbiddenMethod"} (no description key)
- KithError::from(AuthError::Unauthorized) — verify From conversion works
- AuthError Display: assert Display output is non-empty for each variant
